text: APPROVE: the loop body is split into `MergeReportRows` and `AddBranchTotals`, which removes the deeply nested try/foreach/if chain that drove the complexity, so `GatherLcov` is now a single foreach and well under 15 (the helpers also come in well under 15 by my count). The `catch (IOException) { return; }` is equivalent to the old trailing `continue`, partial BRF/BRH sums still accumulate through the `ref` parameters, and the CHA0004 pragma still wraps the catch, so I don't expect new warnings. I reviewed the diff only and did not build or run the tests.
